messages:
marie: Proposal: tenant shadow migration runway for pinned models — trying to keep migrations low-friction for customers while letting us validate perf + quality in prod.
alex: +1, can you sketch phases? want to see ops impact.
sam: curious about evaluation criteria. are we relying purely on automated evals or human spot-checks too?
marie: phases: 1) shadow-only (no opt-in change), 2) small canary cohort (5 tenants), 3) rollout to opt-in cohort (customer-facing opt-in beta), 4) full migration. timeline per-phase: shadow 7 days, canary 48–72h per cohort, opt-in 2 weeks, full 2 weeks ramp.
tess: what about pin exceptions? some customers will need to stay on older pinned model for contract reasons.
marie: we keep pin exceptions as-is. the runway will offer a migration-sideband: a customer can choose opt-in for migration; if they need to stay pinned, we let them with SLA note. ops handles routing.
alex: operational concerns: shadow doubles token load (in terms of compute). need to ensure Dedicated pools can take it. suggest a config flag to cap shadow QPS per tenant.
sam: acceptance gates idea: automated eval score delta <= 0.5% on core L0 eval set, p95 latency delta <= 30ms, token-cost delta <= 10%. also require manual QC pass for any content-sensitive tenants.
marie: agreed. define gating matrix:

- Functional regressions: fail on any new correctness/regression > 0.5% on golden prompt set => block
- Latency: p95 increase > 30ms for tenant baseline => block or rollback
- Cost: token compute cost > +10% => review
- Safety: any new safety hits reported by our classifier => block and escalate

sam: where do we store the golden prompt sets per tenant? current plan: per-tenant seed set in Vault + linked eval job in CI.
marie: yes — devex will provide a template for onboarding teams to populate tenant prompts; product will maintain defaults for common categories.
tess: comms: we need an opt-in email/template + in-console toggle. also a CSV export of tenants who still refuse migration for legal.
marie: noted. UX: in Console: Migration tab with toggle, subset rollout controls, and per-tenant health metrics.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: created pipeline job project/model-migrations/1747001010-runner
alex: ops question: rollback mechanics — how do we switch a tenant back to pinned variant if canary shows regressions?
marie: routing policy supports per-tenant overrides. rollback plan: flip route, purge cache, run quick eval, re-run canary after fixes.
sam: can we do shadow comparison diffing automatically? want a nightly job to compute delta metrics across samples and surface top N failing prompts.
alex: implement a daily job computing: mismatch_rate, avg_confidence_delta, latency_delta. if mismatch_rate > threshold => alert.
marie: thresholds: mismatch_rate > 0.5% on golden set => pager to product/eng oncall; >0.1% => ticket.
tess: regulatory: we must log which model served every response for auditing. include model_version header + rollout id.
marie: yes — add model_version and rollout_id to trace logs and SLA reports. retention: 90 days by default, enterprise option for longer.
ops-bot: Incident bot: created alert rule "migration-mismatch-rate" threshold=0.005 window=1h notify=#eng-oncall
alex: data ops: do we need a shadow sampling rate? full shadow for small canaries, sample for broad shadow to save cost.
marie: propose sampling: shadow sampling 100% for canary tenants, 10% for broad shadow. configurable per-tenant.
sam: evaluation infra: create a nightly summary that includes: top 20 mismatches, per-prompt token-cost diff, signal for hallucination increase.
marie: rollout checklist (initial):
- Onboard tenant golden prompts (product)
- Wire log headers + retention (eng-infra)
- Shadow sampling control (eng-runtime)
- Canary cohort selection + opt-in UX (growth/product)
- Alerting + nightly diffs (eng-sre/data-ops)
- Legal metadata export (sales/ops)

alex: dev task: add route override API endpoint: POST /routes/migration/override {tenant_id, model_version, reason}
marie: timeline: start shadow pilot next week for 3 internal tenants, run 7 days, review stats, spin up canary after go/no-go.
tess: comms draft: "We are rolling out a controlled migration path to newer model versions. You can opt in via Console or stay on your pinned model. We'll surface regressions and provide rollback within 24 hours." + FAQ.
sam: success metrics after full migration: 1) no customer-facing regressions reported > 1/week, 2) mean p95 latency across migrated tenants within 10% of baseline, 3) adoption rate >= 70% after 8 weeks.
marie: any objections? or missing items?
alex: add a budget cap + auto-pause if cost delta > configured threshold per tenant.
marie: added. thanks all — I'll convert this thread into a short spec and link to runbook.
tess: I'll draft comms and the Console mockups.
sam: I'll write nightly-diff job spec and golden-prompt templates.
marie: we'll sync in weekly product triage on Friday for go/no-go.
ops-bot: Reminder: meeting created "Migration runway sync" Fri 11:00 AM — invites sent. :calendar:
